details:
Q1: Suggested fix 2 (giving PR-close runs their own concurrency group in `.github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml`) is outside this issue's locked heal scope. How should this heal handle it?
Choices:
A) Stay inside the locked scope. Port only the #8327 reporting fix to `stable`: in `test-and-mark-stable.yml`, the run-timeout error plus `status=timeout` plus `exit 1`, and `FAILED (no status ...)` plus `PASSED=false` in the results step when a smoke PR exists. Add the matching tests and a changelog fragment. The concurrency-group change reaches `stable` later through the normal main→stable promotion of #8327. The gate will still fail until then, but it will report the real reason. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Include the `cancel_on_pr_close.yml` concurrency change in this heal. The heal-scope marker can't be widened in place, so planning will be held until the intake re-files the issue or an operator grants that path.
C) Fix only the concurrency group, and leave the misleading Phase 7 reporting unchanged. **Note:** this file is outside the locked scope, so it hits the same hold as B. It also leaves the false "SKIPPED"/"ALL PHASES PASSED" output in place.
Q2: Should this heal also include optional hardening item 3? That item makes the Phase 7 candidate filter (`test-and-mark-stable.yml:3347-3357`) prefer `pull_request` runs whose `head_sha` matches the closed smoke PR before it falls back to scheduled runs. `main` does not have this change.
Choices:
A) No. Keep `stable` the same as `main`'s #8327 behaviour, and leave filter changes to a separate issue that lands on `main` first. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Yes. Add the `head_sha` preference to `stable` in this heal, with a contract test. **Note:** this makes `stable` differ from `main` until the same change is ported back.
